title: Fix screen tearing on Xorg with NVIDIA
summary: Enable the composition pipeline to eliminate screen tearing on Xorg. This can be tested temporarily or made permanent.

steps.explain: Test the fix temporarily by assigning the current meta mode with ForceFullCompositionPipeline.
To make it permanent, create or edit /etc/X11/xorg.conf.d/20-nvidia.conf. Add a Screen section with Option "ForceFullCompositionPipeline" "on".

rollback.explain: Remove the configuration file or revert the nvidia-settings assignment.

warnings: This may reduce performance in some OpenGL applications and break some games using Vulkan under Proton.
